name: WSCI 2027
overview: WSCI 2027 is the most important global Tier 2 League of Legends event of the 2027 season and the Tier 2 counterpart to the World Championship. Organized by Riot Games, it takes place in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, from November 10 to November 21, 2027, with a total prize pool of USD 750,000. The qualified teams and format have not been announced.
